substeps.caption: Tray N, the feedstock: 264 labelled jars (82 x 60 mL, 70 x 125 mL, 58 x 250 mL, 54 x 500 mL) in racks of white HDPE, one rack per size.
DAL's elements and master alloys (DAL #146: Al, Si, Mg, Cu, Mn, Cr, Zr, Ti, Fe, Ni, Ce, Sc, Er, Zn, Sn, Li as Al-Li), each in clear glass with a black cap; 100 g goes into each atomizer run.
Tinted for now (legend, top right): the master alloys and the two elements of Al 4047.
The tint is only a highlight, held for a few seconds...
...then it fades back: every jar is the same clear glass with a black cap.
Rows stand 21-41 mm apart front to back, room for the gripper's open fingers; the arm takes a jar from above.
Each rack runs the tray's full width and lifts out whole by its handles. Nothing here draws power: no UPS, no cameras. The bay's overhead camera counts the jars whenever the tray is presented.
